title: Bare-capture suite-abort class still live at 11 sites, including the G25/CA-342 durability pins themselves -- the regression the pin exists to catch aborts the suite instead of failing the pin
MERMAID_QUOTED still has zero readers and its only effect is a guaranteed self-hit in the repo-wide scan; no shared test-excluding grep helper in _harness.sh
Six positive controls still carry no provenance comment -- each proves only that the regex matches a string invented to satisfy it
Four eval-scorer dimension extractions still discard rc and stderr, so a crash fails with an empty score and no diagnosis
T44 AC8 presence-only meta-assertion over test scaffolding passes with 39 of 40 T44 assertions deleted
Nine SKIP paths increment neither PASS nor FAIL; no skip() in _harness.sh and run-all.sh:108 still parses a two-term Results line, so flock-gated lock cases silently never run on macOS
t25_ledger_case's four assertions run only against a fixture the test wrote three lines earlier; no plugin file is read and they cannot fail for any EDM source change
T61_BASH4_RE's six alternation arms are proven by a control exercising arm 1 only; a mis-escaped param-expansion or named-fd arm stays permanently green over a live violation
No assert_count_with_control helper exists; the expect-exactly-N family remains hand-rolled with no path-existence guard, so grep exit 2 reads as a passing zero
CA-441's missing-Task-grant rule still has no must-fail case; its trigger is false on the live tree, so every exits-0 assertion passes whether the rule works or does not exist
PDEBT6 still positively certifies that an initiative with zero recorded audit rounds can converge, with no companion boundary case and no decision comment

NEW: the CA-426 stream-separation regression discards stderr with 2>/dev/null and never asserts the zero-rounds warn appears there, so deleting the warn keeps the pin green -- it proves half of a two-stream contract
VERIFIED FIXED: list --paths exit status captured and a zero-initiative floor added to the blocking test:state-validate job
VERIFIED FIXED: eval:nightly derives RUN_DIR once and gives the absent-dir, missing-run.json, scoring and comparison paths named failing else arms
VERIFIED FIXED: ca473_skill_lines capture now carries || true, so a pseudo-code reword no longer aborts the suite
VERIFIED FIXED: the CA-473 disjointness check and its control are gated on both tokens being non-empty, with an explicit named skip-failure at :9374
VERIFIED FIXED: the code-audit skill's manifest-writing instruction is now format-pinned with a check_absent positive control
VERIFIED FIXED: the warn's lens list is extracted and asserted by exact equality, closing the over-reporting blind spot of substring check
VERIFIED FIXED: both round_type mutation detectors now pair with a rounds|length == 1 assertion, making double-recording detectable
VERIFIED FIXED: the CA-472 tripwire comment filter uses POSIX ^[[:space:]]*# and carries a positive control
